question: Which of the following has the same dimension as that of linear momentum?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Impulse.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Impulse** is the effect of impulsive force.

 
 
• Impulse is the force that changes the momentum of a body,
 
• Impulse has the same dimension as that of linear momentum.</
